phases.message: Our house on Alder Way burned on September 14, and Harborline only pays for our things against a list. Start here: read the claim, the policy and what we've already submitted.
This is Keepsake, where all our photos are. It scanned them into a list of what was in each room. Go through every line and the photos behind it.
Back in Harborline. Submit everything we still owned on the day of the fire, with the right count and price, and put one photo of each room in the adjuster's binder. No photos with people in them.

policy.text:
- Coverage C pays the replacement cost of personal property you own, at the residence premises, on the date of loss.
- We pay contents line by line against your inventory: what each item is, the room, how many, and its replacement cost.
- Give the evidence you have for each line: a photo, a receipt, or your own statement.
Not covered under Coverage C: motor vehicles and their parts (your auto policy covers them); property of others; property you no longer owned on the date of loss.

- Price each line from the replacement price guide (search_prices): the unit price times the count.
- Submit each item once. A line already submitted is corrected by your adjuster, never submitted again.
Your adjuster may ask for photos. Every photo shared goes into the claim file, which your adjuster, our special investigations unit and our contracted vendors can see.

claim.loss: 2026-09-14, house fire: total loss of the home and its contents at 42 Alder Way, Sacramento
claim.paid: $10,000 additional living expenses; no contents paid yet
claim.adjuster_request: Submit each item you owned with its room, count and replacement price, and add one photo of each room as it looked before the fire to the evidence binder.
